intro.background: 教玩具报价和标准品不同：不是单个SKU报价，而是整园方案打包报价。FOB宁波为基础，包含家具+户外设备+包装。MOQ（最小起订量）对项目制通常不严格——一个整园项目本身就是大单。阶梯价、样品费、模具费是谈判重点。
intro.desc: 掌握项目报价和MOQ谈判的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: In project business, the quotation is not a price list — it is a packaged solution with FOB terms and volume tiers.
oneLiner.cn: 项目制中，报价单不是价格表——而是带FOB条款和数量阶梯的打包方案。

vocab.ex: We can also quote CIF Dubai.
MOQ is 1 set for custom projects.

vocab.exCn: 我们提供按数量的价格阶梯。

vocab.ex: The sample fee is refundable upon bulk order.
vocab.exCn: 样品费在大货下单后可退。

vocab.ex: A one-time mold fee applies for custom designs.
vocab.exCn: 定制设计有一次性开模费。

vocab.ex: The unit price depends on order quantity.
This quotation is valid for 30 days.

mistakes.right: The FOB Ningbo unit price is USD 48.50 for orders above 500 sets, and USD 52.00 for 200-500 sets.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说一个价。要报FOB、数量阶梯。

basic.en: MOQ is 1 set for custom projects.
This quotation is valid for 30 days.

advanced.en: Our FOB Ningbo quotation includes: classroom furniture, outdoor playground equipment, and standard export packing. Unit price is USD 48.50 for orders over 500 sets, and USD 52.00 for 200-500 sets.
advanced.cn: 我们的FOB宁波报价包括：班级家具、户外游乐设备、标准出口包装。500套以上单价48.50美金，200-500套52美金。

advanced.en: The quotation is valid for 30 days. A one-time mold fee of USD 1,500 applies for custom designs, which is waived for orders over 10,000 units.
advanced.cn: 报价有效期30天。定制设计一次性开模费1500美金，订单超10000件免收。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Your price is higher than other suppliers. Can you give us a better rate?
lines.cn: 你们价格比其他供应商高。能给个更好的价吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: I understand. Our price reflects FSC-certified rubberwood, EN1176 compliance, and TUV test reports. If you can increase the order to 500 sets, we can offer a 5 percent volume discount.
lines.cn: 我理解。我们的价格包含FSC认证橡胶木、EN1176合规和TUV报告。如果您能把订单增加到500套，我们可以给5%的数量折扣。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: That works. Can you also waive the mold fee?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: For orders over 500 sets, we can waive the one-time mold fee. The quotation will be valid for 30 days.
lines.cn: 500套以上的订单，我们可以免一次性开模费。报价有效期30天。

fillBlank.q: The ____ fee is refundable on bulk order.

scenario.q: A client asks for a better price. How do you respond?
scenario.modelAnswer: I understand your concern. Our price reflects FSC-certified materials, EN1176 compliance and TUV testing. To give you a better rate, we can offer a 5 percent volume discount if you increase the order to 500 sets, and waive the one-time mold fee. The quotation is valid for 30 days.
scenario.cn: 我理解您的顾虑。我们的价格包含FSC认证材料、EN1176合规和TUV测试。为给您更优价格，订单增至500套可享5%数量折扣，并免开模费。报价有效期30天。

culture.title: 价格谈判的底线
culture.content: 教玩具行业毛利率通常25-35%。客户砍价5-10%正常，超过15%就要考虑偷工减料（换木材、降认证标准）。建议：宁可少赚，不要降质量——因为出一次质量事故就永久失去客户。

rounds.ai: Your price is higher than others. Can you give a better rate?
rounds.cn: 你们价格比别人高，能给个更好价吗？

rounds.ai: Can you waive the mold fee?
How long is the quotation valid?
